tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// o rgyan rin po che'i gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub bzhugs// e ma ho/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su// snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje'i byin rlabs g.yos// sprul sku padma 'byung gnas byin brlabs te// 'dzam bu'i gling du 'gro ba'i don la byon// 'gro don rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rje can// o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// bsam pa lhun gyi 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan man chad nas// chos rgyal gdung brgyud tha la ma stong bar// dus gsum rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs// bod kyi chos skyong rgyal po'i gnyen gcig pu// rgyal po chos spyod skyong ba'i thugs rje can// o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la= bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub= sku ni lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad// thugs rjes bod kyi sems can yongs la gzigs// ma rig log pa'i sems can 'dren pa'i dpal// nyon mongs gdul dka'i sems can thabs kyis 'dul// brtse gdung rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rje can// o rgyan= bsam pa= dus ngan snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug pa'i tshe// nang re dgong re bod kyi don la byon// nyi zer 'char sdud mdangs la chibs te byon// yar ngo tshes bcu'i dus su dngos su byon// 'gro don stobs chen mdzad pa'i thugs rje can// o rgyan= bsam pa= lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod dus snyigs ma la// sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga rags// nyon mongs dug lnga rang rgyud spyod pa'i tshe// de 'dra'i dus na bdag 'dra thugs rjes skyobs// dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can// o rgyan= bsam pa= /hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas// chos 'khor gnyen po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe// yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs// o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas// hor sog dmag dpung zlog par the tshom med// o rgyan=

bsam pa= /sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe// mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na// yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol= /o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas// tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel// o rgyan= bsam pa= /'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe// sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na// yid gnyis the tshom med par= /o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas// dbul phongs bkres skom sel bar the tshom med// o rgyan= bsam pa= /las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na// dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gding gis// yid gnyis the tshom med par= /o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas// pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med// o rgyan= bsam pa= /sbas yul nags khrod dben sa snyogs pa'i tshe// kha char bu yug 'tshubs shing lam 'gags na// yid gnyis the tshom med par= /o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyen po'i 'khor dang bcas// chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med// o rgyan= bsam pa= /stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can// 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grim pa'i tshe// yid gnyis the tshom med par= /o rgyan dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas// gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med// o rgyan= bsam pa= /sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis// sgyu lus g.yar po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe// yid gnyis the tshom med par= /o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mor bcas// 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med// o rgyan= bsam pa= /lam srang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe// bsad khyer jag pa'i chom pos nyen pa na// yid gnyis the tshom med par= /o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan// tsau ra mi rgod rngam sems rlag par byed// o rgyan= bsam pa= /gang zhig gshed ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas// mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na// yid gnyis the tshom med par=

/o rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis// gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur// o rgyan= bsam pa= /nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe// gnad gcod sdug bsngal 'du 'phrod nyen pa na// yid gnyis the tshom med par= /o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste// bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye// o rgyan= bsam pa= /sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru// 'khrul snang nyid 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na// yid gnyis the tshom med par= /o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis// 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med// o rgyan= bsam pa= /gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te// 'khrul snang dngos por zhen cing sdug bsngal na// yid gnyis the tshom med par= /o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo ste// sdug bsngal 'khrul ba rtsad nas gzhig par byed// o rgyan= bsam pa= /'gro drug sdug bsngal chen pos nyen pa dang*// khyad par bod kyi rje 'bangs sdug bsngal na// dad gus mos pa'i gdung shugs drag po yis// yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs// o rgyan thugs rjes 'pho gyur med par gzigs// o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes so// ༈ /slob dpon rin po che padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs pa bsam don myur 'grub bzhugs so// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus o rgyan rin po cher// bzod med gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sol// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos rtse gcig gus pas gang shar shugs 'byung du gsol ba btab pa dge/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/

bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
